title: 建立内容与隐私验收测试
description: 先用失败测试固定确认过的身份、内容分组、隐私边界和禁用自动同步要求。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN content tests run before implementation THEN they fail on missing confirmed links/assets and still-public CV or sensitive content; WHEN implementation is complete THEN tests verify all privacy and grouping rules; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-20-haibiao-zhang-homepage-design.md:121
review_initial_requirements: Confirm tests fail for the intended missing behavior before production edits.
review_regression_requirements: Re-run tests against source and built output; verify no assertion is weakened to pass.

title: 整理并隐私处理公开图片
description: 复制头像、微信、论文图和证书，生成网页副本，遮挡证书署名与地址，并获取官方机构标识。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN assets are processed THEN all approved images exist under public/images with stable names; WHEN certificate images are inspected THEN contributor lists and street addresses are obscured while QR/barcodes and required metadata remain visible; WHEN scientific figures are inspected THEN legends and axes are intact; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-20-haibiao-zhang-homepage-design.md:43
review_initial_requirements: Inspect source dimensions and public copies; verify only approved inputs are used.
review_regression_requirements: Visually inspect every output at original detail and verify privacy masks, logo provenance, and image integrity.

title: 更新双语内容与站点数据
description: 把所有确认过的个人资料、论文、经历、开源项目、知识产权和链接写入类型化数据。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN site data is loaded THEN confirmed identity, supervisor, Scholar, GitHub, senpai-skill, publication grouping, IP dates, and bilingual text match the approved design; WHEN privacy scans run THEN excluded quantities, platform name, CV links, and unconfirmed accounts are absent; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-20-haibiao-zhang-homepage-design.md:26
review_initial_requirements: Review bilingual parity, exact external URLs, publication authorship grouping, and privacy exclusions.
review_regression_requirements: Re-run content and privacy tests and inspect generated HTML for excluded strings.

title: 实现双语页面与可访问媒体交互
description: 按模板学术编辑风格完成页面内容、图片预览、微信和通用弹窗，并完善键盘与移动端交互。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN the page opens fresh THEN English is visible and document title is Haibiao Zhang; WHEN language is switched THEN all visible content changes and persists; WHEN media controls are activated THEN correct local images open in a focus-trapped modal that closes by button/backdrop/Escape and restores focus; WHEN desktop/mobile viewports render THEN no clipping or horizontal overflow occurs; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-20-haibiao-zhang-homepage-design.md:73
review_initial_requirements: Review page composition against template character and verify no cards/placeholders or inaccessible custom controls are introduced.
review_regression_requirements: Run Playwright across desktop/mobile, keyboard and reduced-motion paths; inspect screenshots and canvas/image pixels for nonblank media and overlap.

title: 清理旧公开内容并配置 Pages
description: 删除公开简历和模板遗留内容，禁用 Scholar 定时同步，配置 codeocd.github.io 的 canonical 与 GitHub Pages 构建。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN production build runs THEN no CV, legacy route, template media, or Scholar schedule enters dist; WHEN Pages workflow runs THEN it executes the full test gate before upload and targets https://codeocd.github.io; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-20-haibiao-zhang-homepage-design.md:95
review_initial_requirements: Review deletions and workflow permissions; ensure no unrelated template history is removed destructively.
review_regression_requirements: Inspect dist manifest and workflow paths; run the production build and privacy scan.

title: 执行完整本地验收与视觉审查
description: 运行内容、隐私、类型、构建和浏览器测试，并审查桌面与手机截图。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN the full local gate runs THEN all tests and build checks pass with zero unexpected warnings; WHEN screenshots and interactions are inspected THEN all approved media are readable, nonblank, correctly framed, and free of overlap/overflow; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-20-haibiao-zhang-homepage-design.md:117
review_initial_requirements: Check every approved claim against automated evidence before declaring pass.
review_regression_requirements: Verify bilingual, privacy, accessibility, modal, reduced-motion, image, build, and responsive evidence without substituting static checks for browser behavior.

title: 创建仓库并验证线上部署
description: 使用现有 GitHub 登录创建公开仓库、推送已验证代码、启用 Pages 并检查生产网址。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN authenticated GitHub access is available THEN create public codeocd/codeocd.github.io, push the validated branch, enable Actions Pages, and verify https://codeocd.github.io returns the built homepage; WHEN production is checked THEN canonical metadata, external links, language switch, and representative media interactions work; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-20-haibiao-zhang-homepage-design.md:109
review_initial_requirements: Review remote identity, visibility, branch, Pages source, and ensure no credentials enter the repository.
review_regression_requirements: Verify the public URL through a fresh browser session and compare deployed behavior with the local validation evidence.

title: Review documented vision against delivered work
description: Use the strongest available independent review to compare approved design claims with delivered behavior, evidence level, CSV state, validation evidence, and review log.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN all prior non-review rows are closed THEN run an independent review against every ledger claim; WHEN gaps or overstated evidence are found THEN append follow-up issues and REVIEW-02; WHEN no gaps remain and review is not limited THEN close the CSV; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-20-haibiao-zhang-homepage-design.md:129
review_initial_requirements: Verify all prior non-review rows are closed before review.
review_regression_requirements: Check production URL and deployed bilingual identity; check local approved assets and certificate redactions; check privacy exclusions in source and dist; check browser evidence for language persistence, keyboard modals, reduced motion, and desktop/mobile overflow; verify each claim in the ledger has evidence at the promised level.
